items.title: FICO Climbs on Xactus Partnership, Brings New Pricing Flexibility to Mortgage Lenders
items.why: Score pricing flexibility in mortgage signals lenders pushing for cheaper underwriting, a trend that could reach consumer credit tools.
items.summary_ai: FICO announced a partnership with Xactus that gives mortgage lenders more flexible credit score pricing options.
items.take: Score pricing flexibility in mortgage signals lenders pushing for cheaper underwriting, a trend that could reach consumer credit tools.
